name: Zebul
title: The Governor of Shechem
summary: Zebul was the governor (or ruler) of the city of Shechem who served under Abimelech, son of Gideon. He played a crucial role in the conflict between Abimelech and Gaal son of Ebed by warning Abimelech about Gaal's rebellion and helping him crush the resistance in Shechem.

keyEvents.title: Zebul as Governor of Shechem
keyEvents.description: Zebul served as Abimelech's governor and representative in the city of Shechem, where he was responsible for maintaining order and loyalty to Abimelech.

keyEvents.title: Gaal Threatens Abimelech's Rule
keyEvents.description: Gaal son of Ebed came to Shechem and won the people's trust, speaking openly against Abimelech's rule. Zebul heard his rebellious words and became furious.

keyEvents.title: Zebul Sends a Secret Message to Abimelech
keyEvents.description: Zebul secretly sent word to Abimelech, telling him about Gaal's rebellion and urging him to set an ambush against the city at night.

keyEvents.title: Zebul Deceives Gaal
keyEvents.description: When Gaal saw Abimelech's forces approaching, Zebul tried to deceive him by saying that what he saw were only shadows from the mountains, in order to buy time for Abimelech's attack.

keyEvents.title: Zebul Challenges Gaal
keyEvents.description: When Abimelech's army became clearly visible, Zebul mocked Gaal and challenged him to go out and fight against the army he had despised.

keyEvents.title: Gaal Driven Out of Shechem
keyEvents.description: After Gaal was defeated by Abimelech in battle, Zebul drove Gaal and his relatives out of Shechem, thereby securing Abimelech's control over the city.
